description: This source file implements character encoding conversion routines for various code pages, primarily converting between Unicode and OEM code pages, including functions for character conversion and case mapping. It includes a large lookup table for code page 437 and others, supporting character translation and uppercase conversion.

methods.name: ff_convert
methods.description: Converts a Unicode character to OEM code page or vice versa, based on the direction parameter.

methods.name: ff_wtoupper
methods.description: Converts a character to its uppercase equivalent, supporting Unicode characters.
